mapper.sql: c.id, c.institution_id, c.course_code, c.title, c.description, c.classification_code, c.education_type, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.recruit_start_date, c.recruit_end_date, c.capacity, c.location, c.online_url, c.credit_bank_eligible, c.credit_value, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, c.thumbnail_file_id, c.tags, c.target_audiences, c.instructor_profile_visible, c.tuition_type, c.tuition_amount, c.material_fee_type, c.material_fee_amount, c.completion_enabled, c.completion_criteria, c.required_progress_rate, c.issue_certificate, c.notes, c.materials, c.learning_objective, c.selection_method, c.waitlist_capacity

ORDER BY
c.title c.start_date c.created_at
ASC DESC , c.id ASC
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'RECRUITING') AS recruiting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS in_progress, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollments e JOIN tb_course_instructors eci ON eci.course_id = e.course_id WHERE eci.user_id = #{instructorUserId} AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS student_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_inquiries i JOIN tb_course_instructors ici ON ici.course_id = i.course_id WHERE ici.user_id = #{instructorUserId}) AS inquiry_count FROM tb_course_instructors ci JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = ci.course_id WHERE ci.user_id = #{instructorUserId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
